properties.name: Simaluguri to Sivasagar
properties.source: Road route from the Bhuvan Shortest Path API, NRSC/ISRO; flood area from NodiBondhu HAND model
properties.quality: Shortest route by distance, and the service cannot avoid floodwater, so this is not a recommended route. In the flood area does not mean the road is closed, because raised roads can stay dry and the model ignores embankments and bridges. The flood model only partly matches one radar image of the July 2026 flood. Date of the road data is not known
